title: Desktop Commander 0.3.3 — exact added-lock artifact evidence
scope: All 31 added lock paths, deduplicated to 29 exact name/version artifacts. Three previously verified direct tarballs reused, 26 missing artifacts fetched once. No unchanged baseline artifacts were fetched; parent performed closure/path resolution and changed-entry review.

acceptance_limits.identity: Established: all 29 artifacts match corrected-lock SRI, registry SRI and registry SHA-1; source snapshot binds unchanged added entries to the corrected lock.
acceptance_limits.license_evidence: Established for shipped standalone texts and detected embedded notices of all added artifacts. Complete final-distribution rights/notice compatibility is not determined; retain stated embedded-origin limits.
acceptance_limits.install_hooks: No preinstall/install/postinstall declarations in added manifests. Other lifecycle declarations are preserved and must not be summarized as no scripts. No install was performed.
acceptance_limits.native: No new Node addon/WASM/native-library/build prerequisite detected in these artifacts. Forge legacy SWF caveat remains; unchanged baseline and real runtime compatibility are outside this artifact review.
acceptance_limits.provenance: 23 pinned source manifest/license pairs match; MQTT version mismatch and five absent gitHeads remain. Registry signatures/attestations and complete source-to-build reproducibility were not verified.

material_findings.finding: socks@2.8.10 and smart-buffer@4.2.0 each declare prepublish: npm install -g typescript && npm run build. Six worker/broker packages declare prepare: husky and prepublishOnly: npm run build. MQTT declares prepare build, Forge prepublish build, unbash prepack TypeScript build. None of the 29 added unique artifacts declares preinstall, install, or postinstall. These facts do not assert which hooks a particular npm workflow invokes; source or publishing workflows differ from registry dependency consumption.

concat-stream@2.0.0 has an array-valued engines field ["node >= 6.0"] in the lock, registry metadata and shipped manifest. Record this non-object shape rather than silently treating it as a normal engines.node constraint. The highest explicit Node lower bound among the added artifacts is fast-unique-numbers >=18.2.0; no runtime test was performed.

Newly inspected artifacts include the complete Sindre Sorhus MIT notice in commist/leven.js; full Node.js/Joyent MIT texts in readable-stream and Joyent headers in events; regenerator-runtime Facebook/MIT notices in @babel/runtime; Linden Research/Joshua Bell attribution in typedarray; and both split2 copyright-year notices (standalone LICENSE 2014-2018, source header 2014-2021). abort-controller UMD sourcemap embeds an event-target-shim copyright/license pointer. These are captured alongside complete standalone license files.

MQTT browser bundles retain three short bundled notices and do not establish complete licensing for every embedded module. Forge retains MIT, custom Tom Wu, BSD-label and public-domain origin notices; lib/aes.js acknowledges OpenSSL-derived portions without an exact upstream version or separate OpenSSL terms. The complete top-level Forge license offers BSD or GPL v2. These are factual evidence limits, not infringement findings.

No added artifact contains a detected .node, .wasm, native library, platform-native executable, native source prerequisite or binding.gyp, and none declares os/cpu/libc/gypfile restrictions. The only compiled asset candidate is the previously reviewed Forge flash/swf/SocketPool.swf, with no ActionScript source in its tarball. This does not certify unchanged baseline native packages or runtime behavior.

24 of 29 artifacts carry a registry gitHead. Pinned package.json and top-level license bytes match for 23. MQTT alone retains the recorded version-only package manifest mismatch (source 5.15.2 vs tarball 5.16.0). @babel/runtime, @types/readable-stream, @types/ws, typedarray and unbash have no registry gitHead. concat-stream and process stale repository owner URLs were resolved through GitHub API repository redirects; their canonical pinned files match. Matching these selected files does not reproduce a build or authenticate publisher signatures.

@types/readable-stream has 4 regular files plus one directory, versus registry fileCount 5; @types/ws has 5 regular files plus one directory, versus registry fileCount 6. Registry counts match archive entries in these two cases; all available unpacked sizes match. There is no integrity mismatch.

method: Bounded HTTPS downloads, hash comparisons, validated tar parsing and safe non-executable regular-file extraction; static inspection only. Absolute/traversal/backslash paths, links, special files and duplicate paths were rejected. No npm install, upstream code import/execution, build, paid call, repository mutation or production mutation.
